entityDescription:
Muzeiko EOOD /Ltd./ and Muzeiko Foundation (ESA Entity Code: 1000 031 168) are related legal persons, as the Founder and Executive Director of Muzeiko Foundation is also the Executive Director of Muzeiko EOOD /ltd./. Also, the staff of the Foundation works part-time with Muzeiko Ltd. Thereby, despite the fact that the seat of the Foundation is at 6 Malyovitsa Str., the Executive Director and staff work at the registered address of Muzeiko Ltd. 
Furthermore, the projects and programmes initiated and implemented by Muzeiko Foundation are often piloted in the Children's Science Centre which is operated and owned by Muzeiko Ltd., as one of the goals of the Foundation is to „design, organize and perform programs and activities in order to achieve the scopes of the Children’s Science Center Muzeiko”.
In addition, Muzeiko Foundation is granted gratuitous use of a building at 8 Kliment Ohridski blvd., where its educational hub is housed.
Although the administrative address of the Children's Science Centre owned by Muzeiko Ltd. Renowned at international level since 1965 (see note 1 below), awarded in 2006 at the OTC with Distinguished Achievement Award, DORIS Engineering is recognized as one of the world’s leaders in the domain of engineering services.
DORIS’ expertise covers steel /concrete, fixed / floating structures, deck and topsides, subsea developments, mooring systems, marine operations... DORIS is involved at all stages of a project development including: feasibility, screening and conceptual studies, FEED / basic engineering, detailed engineering, procurement services, technical assistance and project management services.
DORIS has also developed a specific expertise in advanced engineering. Indeed DORIS has provided design and engineering services in several specific fields such as Defence, Space and Nuclear, building on a long lasting experience in hydrodynamic analyses, structural analyses, mechanical design and assembly, etc.

Note 1: DORIS Engineering was born in 1965 from an ambitious parent SEGANS. The Company previous name was C.G DORIS from 1965 to 1986. In 1986, the creation of DORIS Engineering saw the specialization of the company in all phases of engineering.

entityDescription:
Museon (Stichting Museum voor het Onderwijs)
As an interactive museum for culture and science it is Museon’s ambition to inspire people to discover the world around them and educate themselves. It is also our mission to encourage people to treat the earth with respect. Museon seeks to realise its ambitions by offering visitors a dynamic and museological learning environment covering both existing and future topics. Our main target groups are families and schools. The museum welcomes around 200.000 visitors yearly.
In line with our carefully selected themes Museon is responsible for developing interesting exhibitions, teaching programmes, activities, lectures, workshops and presentations. Our special collections serve as authentic material for cultural education. Museon maintains an interdisciplinary approach when it comes to developing new educational products, encouraging interaction and active discovery. It dedicates structural attention to new educational forms, in which new media have a key role. Also, Museon provides a platform for social organisations, companies and ministries seeking to spotlight socially relevant and current themes.

Museon in the Hague is an educational museum for science and culture. Our main audience consists of families with children and students/schoolchildren of all ages. We have temporary exhibition spaces were we show interactive exhibitions. The action oriented permanent exhibition, One Planet, is about the 17 SDG’s (Sustainable Development Goals) of the UN (1200 m2). Our Climate Studio, open to the public at large but with a specific school-programme about Climate change, is 100m2

Museon is an active member of the VSC (Dutch association of Science Centres) and ECSITE (The European equivalent) and participates in numerous international projects.


We have around 200.000 visitors per year and some 40.000 schoolchildren/students.

Soon, the Institute of Electronics evolved as a leading scientific institution in these areas of applied physics and engineethe fields of Physical Electronics, Photonics and Quantum Electronics and Radio Sciencring within the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences and in Bulgaria.Through the years, the Institute's research field and structure have developed dynamically in response to the changes taking place in the main trends in applied physics and technologies: materials science and technologies, physics of nano-sized objects and nanotechnologies, nanoelectronics, photonics, opto-electronics, quantum optics, environmental physics and monitoring, biomedical photonics and biomedical applications. A part of the research efforts are directed to clarifying the processes of interaction of optical and microwave electromagnetic radiation with the Earth's atmosphere and surface; developing experimental systems for laser remote sensing and monitoring of the atmosphere, including ground-based lidar measurements for validation of satellite lidar data for atmospheric aerosol content vertical profiling; developing algorithms and techniques for signals and information processing; constructing units and systems for lidar/radar and communication applications; studying non-linear processes in optical communication media. At present, the Institute of Electronics is an internationally recognized scientific institution conducting research in a range of modern fields in physics and technologies.

entityDescription:
Gom Schoonhouden is a financially healthy and solid company. This gives you the certainty of a partner who guarantees its services to you even in financially challenging times. A nice feeling.

Of course we clean. That is our profession for more than 50 years. Our mission is: to make everyone happy with cleaning. We do this based on our belief that a clean environment adds value to everyone. By focusing specifically on the motives of our customers, they experience us as the best party to implement this. Now and in the future.

What distinguishes us from other cleaning companies is that we are the first cleaning company in the Netherlands with a specific approach for each sector. Because every sector has its own questions and wishes. That is why Gom consists of six sector-specified business units: In addition to Gom Specialist cleaning (from which you receive this quote), also Offices, Education, Care, Hospitality and Food & Industry (Kleentec). Each of these business units is dedicated to that sector every day. This enables us to better understand what the sector is about and how we can contribute to the realization of your goals. With sector-oriented innovations for example and by working together with the other business units. In the field of hospitality, for example, we learn a lot from our Hospitality business unit, which has a great deal of knowledge and experience with its focus on hotels. And we can help you with that again.
